CustomField.label: Student Id
CustomField.description: 18-character Id of the student (WhoId) as text. Flow cannot read or filter AttendanceEntry.WhoId (deploy error: "The field WhoId for the object AttendanceEntry doesn't exist"), so the nightly scoring flow filters on this formula instead. Origin: SCA-9.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The student's record Id, for automation.
